title: Vaishnavism Saints Namdev
definition: Namdev (1270–1350 CE) was a seminal Marathi saint-poet of the Varkari tradition, known for his egalitarian devotion to Vithoba (a form of Vishnu/Krishna) and his significant contribution to the Guru Granth Sahib.
importanceInUpsc: Namdev represents the bridge between the Marathi Bhakti movement and the North Indian Sant tradition, frequently appearing in questions regarding the evolution of vernacular literature and socio-religious reform.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Vaishnavism Saints Namdev.
